answer: Because the timing is recorded against the nectar challenge, the vault audit can replay the yarrow history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 61 submissions and hold every participant open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which burns the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 8 epochs. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
